title: Keyboard
resetHelp: Uses the layout chosen when Omarchy was installed
consoleHelp: Sets the console keymap to %1 (asks for your password)
override: hypr/input.lua sets kb_layout itself and wins over these presets. Remove those lines.
tip: Keyboard without a / ? key: on ABNT2, AltGr + Q types / and AltGr + W types ?
switchHint: Left Alt + Right Alt switches layouts
preset.br-thinkpad.help: Brazilian ThinkPads: the / ? key next to Right Shift sends Right Ctrl
preset.br-abnt2.help: Standard Brazilian keyboard with Ç and the / ? key
preset.br-thinkpad-us.help: Both layouts, switch with Left Alt + Right Alt
preset.br-us.help: For a laptop in ABNT2 plus an external US keyboard
preset.us-intl.help: US keyboard with dead keys for accents; AltGr + , types ç
preset.us-altintl.help: Quotes and backtick type directly; accents only with AltGr
consent:
Applying a preset changes your configuration:
• ~/.config/omarchy/keyboard-layouts
• ~/.config/hypr/keyboard_options.lua
• one line added to ~/.config/hypr/input.lua

A backup of each file is saved first in ~/.config/omarchy/keyboard-presets/backups.
